scripts.dev: npm run dev -w apps/api & npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.build:render: npm run prisma:generate -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.start:render: npm run prisma:deploy -w apps/api && npm run start -w apps/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.format: npm run format -w apps/api && npm run format -w apps/web
